subject: Patient-derived brain organoids predicted who responded to an antidepressant
script: From Agewell Brief: Patient-derived brain organoids predicted who responded to an antidepressant. Researchers used patient-derived brain organoids to reveal why some people with Alzheimer's may respond to an antidepressant while others don't, and identified tiny particles that could one day aid diagnosis. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
